card.name: Section number cross-references like 7.1
card.fires_on: The decimal point after the number 7 in label cross-references such as 'see Drug Interactions (7.1)'. It also fires on a digit inside a DOI number.

modes.label: Drug Interactions section number
modes.description: The period after 7 inside a bracketed pointer to the Drug Interactions section.

modes.label: Digit in a DOI
modes.description: A digit within a DOI web address in a reference list.

card.writes: Suppresses 'day' and 'days' forms, so it steers the model away from a duration word after a section number.
card.plain: It marks the point in a label's section reference, like (7.1), where a number continues rather than a time span such as days.
